email.body1:
John, saw ASI launched OpenWater AI and announced the iMIS partnership with FUSE Next for AI-powered content discovery.

New AI capabilities and partnerships usually open more in-market accounts than the team can touch before everyone ramps on the message, and that is where pipeline cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for ASI off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for ASI.

With a stronger AI story to sell into associations, the target list usually outruns the team's capacity to work it. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ASI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to peer association-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
